trustedExpectedPathProof: Only Open-Chain initial inspection and Assert-ChainStable held/fresh inspection call Read-Identity.

Open-Chain calls full Assert-Root before constructing expected component strings. Every prefix has the same validated ordinary drive and complete validated segments, with no larger length than the full path.
Request roots are normalized to backslashes before chain use; relative paths are fully validated and converted before full-path construction.
Expected strings are existing immutable string values retained in request-local chain entries; no entry path is derived from the returned native identity or untrusted response.

Each native observation still calls GetFinalPathNameByHandleW, validates count and the exact native prefix, strips it and compares the entire result to the validated expected path using the same OrdinalIgnoreCase comparer.

Within the supported ordinary drive-path grammar, case-only differences do not introduce separators, control characters, ADS, dot segments, reserved names or invalid suffixes. Native ordinary-drive spelling and expected path provenance remain part of trusted OS/helper authority.
The complete original observed finalPath string remains in the returned Identity. Assert-SameIdentity still compares all seven fields case-sensitively, preserving exact post-read stability.

freshnessMatrix.requiredObservations: Every ancestor opens and receives fresh native identity/final path; type/reparse/link/volume checks remain.
Every held component is reobserved with native information, file type and final path, then compared to original seven-field identity.
Every required path is reopened and freshly observed, compared, then closed; no pre-read native state substitutes for that observation.
Held and reopened native checks repeat for root chain after file set.
Shared Read-Identity uses same unchanged native calls and checked expected prefixes; full operation sequence and no-overlap authority remain.
